discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in c8204138. `validate_stage` now re-validates the staged `herdr.exe`, and `archive_bundle` calls `validate_stage`, so a direct `archive` of an existing stage or a swap after staging is rejected. The staging test now replaces `herdr.exe` with a dynamic-CRT PE after staging and asserts `validate_stage` fails.
